research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Platform Science is researching secure wireless networks for vehicles, dynamic wireless connection management, and remote mobile device management, as described in titles such as Secure Wireless Networks For Vehicles and Remote Mobile Device Management. Their work includes methods for generating standardized vehicle data, identifying and mitigating problematic devices, and micro-navigation for vehicles. These areas focus on enhancing telematics, fleet management, and operational efficiency.

overview_description.description: Platform Science is an enterprise-grade IoT fleet management platform for the new era of connected trucks, freight, and the digital supply chain. Since its launch in 2015, Platform Science has spent thousands of hours working with fleets to make transportation smart. The company is based in San Diego, California, United States.

product.name: Virtual Vehicle
product.description: A connected-vehicle platform that links commercial trucks, onboard systems, driver applications, and fleet software through a configurable technology layer.

product.name: PS Fleet Solutions
product.description: A SaaS fleet management platform combining telematics, compliance, productivity, and safety tools for commercial fleet operations.

product.name: Instinct Fleet Solutions
product.description: A fleet operations suite that connects driver applications, back-office management, asset tracking, log auditing, and video safety capabilities.

product.name: Video Intelligence
product.description: A fleet video safety solution that captures and analyzes vehicle and driver footage to support safety management, incident review, and liability protection.

product.name: PS Apps
product.description: A suite of in-cab fleet applications for hours-of-service logging, inspections, navigation, media, workflows, messaging, and analytics.

product.name: Virtual Vehicle Marketplace
product.description: An ecosystem for discovering and integrating third-party fleet applications, hardware, and services across transportation technology categories.
